No session, or the second factor is still outstanding.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Prefix of the port name, its UN/LOCODE or its country. Omit for the first page in name order.

status.description: pending is the normal resting state while no transport is configured: built and held, not lost. skipped means a switch told us not to send it.

transportConfigured.description: False while the CargoWise transport is held, which is the case today.

trackable.description: False when the platform cannot yet observe this step, so the screen offers it without claiming to know whether it is finished.

permissions.description: Permission codes the viewer holds; the screen shows a block only when its permission is present.

signInMethod.description: Which identity provider this account signs in with.

contacts.description: Named Noatum contacts for this customer. Empty until contact assignment exists; the servicing branch above is what we can say today.

records.description: What is visible to this account right now. Real counts, not a progress estimate.

userCount.description: Users on this customer, including those who have not accepted yet.

roleNames.description: Display names for the same roles.

officeName.description: Null when the user sees every linked office.

isSelf.description: True for the person making the request; the screen cannot let them lock themselves out.

permissions.description: What the role grants, for the "what can they do" line.

resendCount.description: Resends used. Three is the maximum.

inviteUrl.description: The single-use link, returned ONLY on creation and only while no email transport is configured, so an administrator can pass it on themselves.

officeAccountId.description: Restrict to one linked office. Null means all of them.

blocked.description: True when the customer is not live and cannot go live yet.

isSourceConfirmed.description: Only a source-confirmed organisation may be linked.

blockedReason.description: Why this organisation cannot be attached.
Why this task is not done yet.

sourceActive.description: False when the organisation is inactive in CargoWise.

servicingBranchCode.description: Set on this link only; null means it follows the customer default.

effectiveServicingBranchCode.description: The office that actually services this link, after the customer default is applied.

servicingInherited.description: True when the office comes from the customer default rather than this link.

blocked.description: True when the customer is not live and cannot go live yet.

goLiveMissing.description: Empty when the customer can go live.

updatedAt.description: The value last read, for optimistic concurrency.
The value last read, for optimistic concurrency.

inviteLink.description: The single-use link, returned ONLY on creation and only while no email transport is configured, so staff can pass it on themselves.

credentialDisabled.description: An administrator has blocked this password.

pendingActivationLink.description: An unused activation link is still live.

seesAllOrganisations.description: True when no restriction rows exist, so the user sees every linked organisation.

changed.description: False when there was nothing to do - already disabled, no factor to clear.

link.description: The single-use link, returned only while no email transport is configured so staff can pass it on. Never stored.

key.description: Stable key, e.g. "quote_decision". Picks the icon and the wording.

badge.description: The deadline or state, e.g. "Expires in 10 days".

tone.description: How urgent the badge reads. Never the only signal - the text says it too.

cta.description: What the customer does about it, e.g. "Review".

href.description: In-app path. Empty when the destination has not shipped.

key.description: One of shipments | on_time | door_to_door | spend | balance.

value.description: Already formatted, e.g. "EUR 384k" or "30.3". The server owns rounding.

unit.description: e.g. "days". Null when the value carries its own.

delta.description: e.g. "17%" or "3.8 pts". Null when there is nothing to compare with.

deltaDirection.description: Direction of travel only. Whether up is good is the tile's business, not the arrow's.

deltaTone.description: What the change means for the customer, decided here so the screen never guesses.

caption.description: The quiet line, e.g. "vs prior 12 months" or "target 90%".

spark.description: The sparkline, oldest first. Empty when there is no history.

month.description: First day of the month, ISO date.

spendMinorUnits.description: Minor units of the dashboard currency.

key.description: One of booked | at_origin | in_transit | at_destination | in_customs.

date.description: ISO date of the expected arrival or next event.

reference.description: Container, booking or air waybill reference.

note.description: The one sentence that says where it is.

deliveredRecently.description: Delivered in the last 30 days, for the caption.

percent.description: Whole percent arrived inside the quoted window.

quotedMinDays.description: The transit a pricing specialist quoted, in days.

actualMinDays.description: What actually happened, fastest and slowest.

trend.description: Spend by month on this lane, oldest first.

sharePercent.description: Share of total spend, whole percent.

key.description: Charge group key, e.g. "freight". Mapped, never a CargoWise code.

tone.description: Which rail colour the slice takes. Avoidable cost is drawn in the action colour.

note.description: The one thing worth saying about the split, e.g. what demurrage cost and why.

termsDays.description: Payment terms in days, for the caption.

overdueMinorUnits.description: Overdue past terms, the figure the balance tile warns on.

percent.description: Share of total emissions, whole percent.

basis.description: The methodology, e.g. "Well to wheel, GLEC-aligned estimate".

note.description: The comparison worth making, e.g. air being a small share of moves and a large share of carbon.

asOf.description: When the figures were last refreshed from the system of record.

source.description: Where these figures came from. `sample` means generated for a pilot environment and must be said so on screen - a customer reading an invented spend as their own is the failure this field exists to prevent.

currency.description: ISO 4217, e.g. EUR. Every minor-unit figure on this DTO is in it.

firstName.description: The viewer's first name, for the greeting.

officeNames.description: Offices this account sees, for the subtitle.

inFlightCount.description: In flight right now, across every mode.

arrivingSoonCount.description: Arriving in the next ten days.

customerVisible.description: Only meaningful on to_customer. Defaults to true.
False means the customer cannot see this document at all.

label.description: English fallback; the client translates by key.

overridden.description: False while the switch sits at its code default.

requiresApproval.description: Turning this on needs a recorded approval reference.

protected.description: Invariants that are deliberately not switches.

state.description: authenticated: done. mfa_required: a code is needed. mfa_enrolment_required: a second factor must be set up before anything else.

csrfToken.description: Send this in x-csrf-token on every state-changing request.

revoked.description: Sessions ended besides the one that asked. Zero is a normal answer, not a failure: it means this was the only session.

secret.description: Base32 secret, for keying in by hand.

uri.description: otpauth:// URI for the QR code.

codes.description: Shown once. Only hashes are kept, so this list cannot be re-issued.

recoveryCodesLeft.description: Unused recovery codes left. Below three is worth acting on.

mfaRequired.description: True when a second factor cannot be removed, only replaced.

sourceRef.description: Where the seeded content came from.

parentCategoryCode.description: Category an item parent must belong to. Null means flat.

canEditContent.description: False for source and system lists: their content is owned elsewhere.

canRetire.description: Whether values here may be activated or retired. True for portal and source lists; false for system lists, which mirror application enums.

customerVisibleCount.description: Items reachable by a customer surface.

completeLocales.description: Locales with a label on every item.

parentCategoryCode.description: Its own code makes the list self-nesting.

source.description: Where the record came from: 'manual' until an authoritative import exists.

servicedCount.description: Active customer links this branch services.

cw1Code.description: CargoWise ControllingBranch code seen on imported organisations.

organisationCount.description: Active organisations carrying this controlling branch.

label.description: Null when the code is not in the catalogue yet.

purposes.description: What the address is used for.

sourceBranchCode.description: CargoWise ControllingBranch, not the Noatum office.

linkServicingBranchCode.description: Office servicing this link, after the customer default is applied.

linkServicingInherited.description: True when the office comes from the customer default rather than this link.

errors.description: Rejections and any refusal by the deactivation brake.

authoritative.description: True only for a complete snapshot that may deactivate absent organisations.

code.description: UN/LOCODE. Store this, not the name.

countryName.description: Country name for the caller locale, from the country lookup. Null if that lookup has no row for the code.

subdivision.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision, where the directory records one.

claimExpiresAt.description: Null when unclaimed. Lets the screen count down without re-deriving the setting.

claimedByMe.description: True when the acting user holds the claim.

commodity.description: What is being moved, as submitted.

claimExpiresAt.description: Null when unclaimed. Lets the screen count down without re-deriving the setting.

claimedByMe.description: True when the acting user holds the claim.

customerBranchName.description: Servicing office for this customer. The quiet second line under the name.

customerQuoteCount.description: How many quotations this customer has in total. Context, not a filter.

daysRemaining.description: Whole days until the offer lapses, floored. Null when nothing is published.

ownerInitials.description: Initials of whoever holds the work. Null when nobody does.

marginPercent.description: Sell minus cost over sell, one decimal. Null unless cost capture is on, the caller holds pricing.cost.view, and a cost was actually recorded - it is never stored, only derived.

pipeline.description: Counted across the branch, ignoring the segment filter itself.

unclaimed.description: Quotations in the branch that nobody has claimed.

maySeeMargin.description: Whether the margin column carries anything for this caller. False hides it rather than printing a column of dashes.

subsidiaryRisks.description: Further hazards the substance also presents.

packingGroup.description: 'NONE' where the entry is not assigned one.

appliesToLines.description: lineId values from payload.packages - which cargo holds this entry.

unitId.description: Stable id within the request; dangerous goods entries name it.

grossWeightPerUnitKg.description: Expected load per container. Indicative; the CSC plate binds.

toleranceCelsius.description: Plus or minus. Zero means none, which differs from not stated.

amountMinorUnits.description: quantity x rate, computed by the API.

costMinorUnits.description: Internal cost PER UNIT, mirroring rateMinorUnits beside it. Absent unless costCapture is on AND the caller holds pricing.cost.view.

freeTimeDays.description: Free time at destination, in days.

totalMinorUnits.description: Sum of the charge lines, minor units.

costTotalMinorUnits.description: Internal cost total. Null when not permitted.

marginPercent.description: Derived, never stored: (sell - cost) / sell as a percentage. Null when cost is not permitted.

code.description: Stable code. Store this, not the label.

version.description: Customer-visible. Bumped when a published quote is re-priced.

loadType.description: FCL, LCL, FTL or LTL. Null where the mode carries no load type.

originName.description: From the port directory, so the lane can read Qingdao and not only CNTAO.

currency.description: The currency the customer asked to be quoted in. A new option starts here.

accountName.description: The account the request was raised against, e.g. "Valencia office".

cw1OrgCode.description: That account's CargoWise organisation code. Resolved here, never sent by the client.

requestedByName.description: Who at the customer submitted it. Null once that user is removed.

notes.description: The CUSTOMER's remarks. Never written by staff.

messageToCustomer.description: The pricer's covering draft. Sent only on publish.

payload.description: Cargo lines and the long tail of the request, as submitted.

dangerousGoods.description: What the customer declared. Empty when the request carries none.

equipment.description: What a per-container charge multiplies by. Empty unless a full-load request.

oversizeItems.description: Lifting equipment is quoted per piece.

pricedById.description: So the screen can honour the four-eyes rule.

pricedByMe.description: True when the acting user priced it and so may not approve it.

disclosesCarrier.description: quotations.disclose - does the customer see the carrier.

defaultValidityDays.description: Default validity in days, pre-filled on a new option.

approvalThresholdMinorUnits.description: Approval threshold in EUR minor units.

chargeBases.description: Suggested charge bases. A hint list, never validation.

carrierOptions.description: Carriers from the `carrier` lookup, filtered to this quote's mode. A suggestion list: the field still accepts any name typed.

chargeCodes.description: Charge codes from the `charge_code` lookup. Code and meaning both, because FRT tells a new pricer nothing. A suggestion list: the field still accepts any code typed.

currencyOptions.description: Currencies from the `currency` lookup, for the per-line currency column.

costMinorUnits.description: Refused unless cost capture is permitted.

total.description: Decimal major units, for wording only.

rate.description: Decimal major units as the carrier wrote it. Blank when scaffolded.

reason.description: Why this line is here. Shown beside it, never stored.

indicative.description: True where the rate is a demonstration figure.

optionIndex.description: Which option the answer belongs to. -1 for the quote.

say.description: What the assistant says, in order.

derived.description: Why it proposed what it did.

options.description: Proposed options. Empty for a brief.

target.description: Whether the SPA should rewrite the open option or add one.

indicative.description: True where the rates are demonstration figures a pricer must replace.

message.description: A covering note draft. Present only for want=message.

openRequests.description: Requests with pricing still to come.

withOptionsReady.description: Of those, how many already have options to read.

expiringThisWeek.description: Published quotes whose validity ends within seven days.

accepted.description: Accepted in the last twelve months.

priced.description: Priced in the same window, the denominator for the rate.

medianHoursToPrice.description: Median hours from request to published options. Null until anything has been priced.

instantPercent.description: SAMPLED. Share answered from a contract rate with no person involved.

savedVsSpotMinorUnits.description: SAMPLED. Minor units saved against market spot, year to date.

state.description: Which of the three states this card is in. Decides its rule and badge.

badge.description: The badge text, e.g. "Expires in 3 days".

fromMinorUnits.description: Cheapest published option. Null while the request is still with the pricing desk.

validUntil.description: ISO date the price stops holding.

deskName.description: Who is pricing it, where a request is with the desk. Never an internal id.

count.description: Null where the platform cannot count it yet.

movePercent.description: Percent of the previous step that reached this one.

contractMinorUnits.description: What this customer pays on contract, minor units.

spotMinorUnits.description: SAMPLED. Market spot for the same lane and equipment.

savingPercent.description: Average saving against spot across the window, whole percent.

key.description: A load type or handling case, e.g. "Sea FCL" or "Dangerous goods".

hours.description: Median hours. Null when nothing has been priced.

instant.description: SAMPLED. True where a contract rate answers without a person.

sentAt.description: ISO date the request was sent.

status.description: The pipeline segment key, for the pill.

next.description: What happens next, or what happened, in one phrase.

sampled.description: Panels whose figures are generated rather than measured. The screen marks these and only these.

funnelNote.description: The one thing worth saying about the funnel, e.g. how many lapsed unanswered.

statusBadge.description: Coarse grain. claimed, priced and approved all collapse to in_progress.

optionCount.description: Options the customer can see. Zero before publication.

awaitingDecision.description: Published, in date, and not yet answered.

cargo.description: What is being moved, in parts. The browser writes the caption.

daysRemaining.description: Whole days until the offer lapses, floored. Null when nothing has been published. Zero or less means it has lapsed.

pipelineSegment.description: Which band of the pipeline this row belongs to. Derived by the server so the segment count, the segment filter and the row agree.

pipeline.description: The pipeline band. Counted across everything the customer may see, ignoring the segment filter itself, so picking a segment does not erase the others.

customerName.description: The signed-in customer's own name, for the band's eyebrow. Resolved under the caller's own tenancy, so it can only ever be their own.

carrierName.description: Null when the branch does not disclose the carrier before booking.

isExpired.description: Past its validity. Decided by the server clock, because that is the clock that will refuse the acceptance.

statusBadge.description: Coarse grain. claimed, priced and approved all collapse to in_progress.

optionCount.description: Options the customer can see. Zero before publication.

awaitingDecision.description: Published, in date, and not yet answered.

daysRemaining.description: Whole days until the offer lapses, floored. Null when nothing has been published. Zero or less means it has lapsed.

pipelineSegment.description: Which band of the pipeline this row belongs to. Derived by the server so the segment count, the segment filter and the row agree.

status.description: The raw status. Use statusBadge for display.

stageIndex.description: Completed steps of the five-step journey.

loadType.description: load_type lookup code; absent for air.

payload.description: The request as submitted, for review and for copying.

dangerousGoods.description: What the customer declared. Shown back to them so they can check it.

lineId.description: Stable id for this line, so a dangerous goods entry can name it.

packingGroup.description: 'NONE' where the entry is not assigned one.

appliesToLines.description: lineId values this entry travels in. At least one.

grossWeightPerUnitKg.description: Expected load per container. Indicative; nothing refuses on it.

toleranceCelsius.description: Plus or minus. Zero is valid.

payload.description: The long tail of the request: handling flags, customs data, parties.

version.description: The version the customer was looking at.

value.description: The value that applies, after the hierarchy has been walked.

source.description: Which layer supplied the value. The screen prints this.

valid.description: False when the stored value no longer fits the catalogue, so the resolver skips it.

label.description: English fallback; the client translates by key.

requiresSwitch.description: Platform switch that must be on for this setting to be read at all.

pendingActivationLink.description: An unspent invitation or reset link is live.

usesSso.description: Signs in with Microsoft, so needs no portal password.

security.description: Null when portal password sign-in is switched off.

link.description: Present only while no email transport is configured.
